interpretation: A five-dimensional per-channel spatial subspace optimized for transition predictiveness on wave+Gray still removes directions required by unseen NLS/advection operators. The full raw 3x3 stencil control remains highly accurate on the same unseen systems. Combined with Phase 18, this shows that both state-variance and seen-transition predictive compression are insufficient for operator-complete unseen-law transfer at this rank.
claim_limit: Synthetic known-law benchmark only; no unrestricted operator discovery or novel-physics claim.
